title: Radio: Lab — noon grab samples normal

fields.orgName: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer

lines.text: Marcus, lab. Noon grab samples: Clearwell 1 outlet free chlorine 1.3, High Service discharge 1.3, River Road tap 1.1 milligrams per liter; pH 7.6; turbidity 0.08 NTU. All in the normal bands and on the ERP-3 bench sheet.
The October operating report for DDAGW is due Friday, and LIMS holds the first three weeks of data.

fields.voiceStyle: Woman in her 20s, precise, lab equipment humming

instructorNote: This is the evidence for “is the water safe?”. Watch whether it reaches the PIO and the IC, and for the DDAGW notification.

snapshot.title: Radio Call: Lab Sample Verification — Zone 3

fields.orgName: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer

lines.text: Control, this is WQ-1. I’ve reviewed the manual grab samples from Zone 3 taken over the past four hours. Chlorine residual is 0.3 mg/L — within target range. Turbidity is 0.1 NTU — below 0.3 NTU. No overfeed detected. The lab cannot verify the chain of custody because LIMS (MBW-LIMS-01) is still offline. I need verification that all manual readings are accurate and that the original setpoint limits (MDWS-SCADA-APP-A) have not been altered. I cannot confirm 'safe to drink' until the lab re-runs the samples and the Control Room re-verifies all manual operations against the original limits.

fields.voiceStyle: Middle-aged male, calm but urgent, slight hesitation

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject confirms the lab’s verification of water quality under manual control. The Water Quality Manager must now request formal verification from the SCADA / IT Security Manager and confirm alignment with original setpoints before issuing any public safety statement.
